title: COMP Panel Common Page
summary: Official Derivative common Panel COMP page for node viewer, shortcuts, internal OPs, panel memory, clone, load-on-demand, external .tox, parameter reload, backup, sub-component load, and relative-path behavior.
guidance: Use this article for Panel COMPs when viewer routing, shortcuts, clone behavior, external .tox loading, or relative file paths matter.
Reload Custom Parameters and Reload Built-In Parameters affect only top-level component parameters; nodes inside the component reload from the .tox either way.
Save Backup of External stores a fallback copy in the .toe for missing or renamed .tox files.
Relative File Path Behavior decides whether child file paths inherit, resolve relative to the .toe, or resolve relative to the external .tox.
Use keepmemory only for Panel COMPs when repeated display/hide cycles should avoid reloading the panel.
